mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine is a prodrug that converts to amphetamine, which inhibits monoamine reuptake; combined with phenelzine (MAOI) causes excessive monoamine accumulation leading to hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: This combination is contraindicated; do not use together and maintain at least 14 days washout between discontinuing phenelzine and starting lisdexamfetamine or vice versa.
